newsitem.title: TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO: CRICKET-WILLIANS HITS MAIDEN TEST CENTURY.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WILLIANS HITS MAIDEN TEST CENTURY.

text.p: Opener Stuart Williams completed his maiden test century as West Indies headed towards safety in the second test against India on Tuesday.
Williams reached three figures just before lunch on the fifth and final day when West Indies, 140 behind on first innings, were 192 for one at the interval.
They led by 52 with two sessions remaining, and the game looked set for a draw. The opening test in the five-match series was drawn.
Williams, having made 63 of the overnight 118 for one, scored his century off 241 balls in 355 minutes, hitting one six and nine fours.
The opener, playing his 14th test, was unbeaten on 102 at lunch, having shared a record, unbroken second wicket partnership of 167 with left-hander Shivnarine Chanderpaul, who was 71 not out.
They beat the previous best at Queen's Park Oval for West Indies against India of 119 between Easton McMorris and Rohan Kanhai in the 1961-62 series.
